proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3196 identifies *kādṛk as the remodelled what interrogative behind Gujarati kaya and Marathi kāy. The kay/kaye forms fit; koī/kɔī needs distinguishing the indefinite pronoun. Reviewed comparator: Marw kāy “what?” (f_3jsxhnw4vopqw). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.
